basis: R103 115 lb (2025 kickoff V0 pp. 76/86/112 per the mass-01 ruleBasis) and the project 9 V branch floor, the same limits as the pan baseline

lip-deploy-nominal.duty: Release the lip latch at match start (servo stall 1.5 A, robot stationary)

lip-deploy-weak.duty: Release the lip latch at match start (servo stall 1.5 A, robot stationary)

receive-chute-nominal.duty: Docked at the station; the nip position hold may reach its 30 A limit for the receive impact

receive-chute-weak.duty: Docked at the station; the nip position hold may reach its 30 A limit for the receive impact

receive-pocket-nominal.duty: Docked at the station; the nip position hold may reach its 30 A limit for the receive impact

receive-pocket-weak.duty: Docked at the station; the nip position hold may reach its 30 A limit for the receive impact

leave-station-nominal.duty: Drive the loaded robot at up to 1.70 m/s cruise with module re-azimuth; the nip position hold draws up to 5 A

leave-station-weak.duty: Drive the loaded robot at up to 1.70 m/s cruise with module re-azimuth; the nip position hold draws up to 5 A

seat-pipe-nominal.duty: Docked at the station; the nip position hold may reach its 30 A limit for the receive impact

seat-pipe-weak.duty: Docked at the station; the nip position hold may reach its 30 A limit for the receive impact

carry-power-off-hit-nominal.duty: Carry a seated pipe with every motor output off: main power off (0 A) or disabled with only the controls drawing

carry-power-off-hit-weak.duty: Carry a seated pipe with every motor output off: main power off (0 A) or disabled with only the controls drawing

eject-nip-nominal.duty: Run the nip under its 30 A limit while docked at the reef

eject-nip-weak.duty: Run the nip under its 30 A limit while docked at the reef

eject-trough-nominal.duty: Run the nip under its 30 A limit while docked at the reef

eject-trough-weak.duty: Run the nip under its 30 A limit while docked at the reef

withdraw-park-nominal.duty: Drive the loaded robot at up to 1.70 m/s cruise with module re-azimuth; the nip position hold draws up to 5 A

withdraw-park-weak.duty: Drive the loaded robot at up to 1.70 m/s cruise with module re-azimuth; the nip position hold draws up to 5 A
